speaker: Doctor
text: The fundoscopic findings of granular yellow-white opacities and hemorrhages, combined with your critically low CD4 count, are highly characteristic of Cytomegalovirus (CMV) retinitis. DIAGNOSIS READY: CMV Retinitis
